posts.title: How to Tell If a Promo Code Will Work Before You Use It
posts.excerpt: Five quick checks that save you from dead codes, hidden exclusions and surprise renewal prices.
posts.author: CouponBuz Team
posts.seoTitle: How to Tell If a Promo Code Will Work (5 Quick Checks)
posts.seoDescription: Learn five quick checks to spot expired, restricted or misleading promo codes before you reach checkout.
posts.body:
A code that fails at checkout wastes your time and sometimes nudges you into paying full price. These five checks take under a minute.

## 1. Look for a recent check date
A code with no date is a guess. Prefer listings that say when they were last tested and drop anything older than a few weeks for fast-moving retailers.

## 2. Read the exclusions
Most percentage codes exclude sale items, gift cards or certain brands. If your basket is mostly excluded items, the code will not apply.

## 3. Check the minimum spend
A code that needs a high basket total may push you to buy more than you planned. Work out whether the saving is still worth it.

## 4. Confirm region and account rules
Many codes work only in one country or only for new customers. If you are shopping from the UK, a US-only code will be rejected.

## 5. Look at the renewal price
For subscriptions and hosting, the first-term discount is often the headline. Note what the service charges after that period before you enter payment details.

If a code still fails, clear the basket, re-enter it exactly as shown and make sure you are signed in to the right account.

posts.title: Black Friday Savings Checklist: Prepare Before the Sales Start
posts.excerpt: A practical checklist for the busiest shopping week, from price tracking to delivery deadlines.
posts.author: CouponBuz Team
posts.seoTitle: Black Friday Savings Checklist for US, UK, CA & EU Shoppers
posts.seoDescription: Prepare for Black Friday with a simple checklist: track prices, set a budget, compare totals and check return windows.
posts.body:
Black Friday rewards people who prepare. Use this checklist in the weeks before the sales.

## Build a short wish list
Write down the five or six things you actually need. Impulse buys are where most of the money disappears.

## Record today's prices
Note the current price of each item now. During the sale, you will know whether a banner discount is real or calculated from an inflated list price.

## Set a total budget
Decide the maximum you will spend and stick to it, including delivery costs.

## Check delivery and return windows
Items bought during the sales often come with longer return windows, but not always. Confirm the dates for your country before you pay.

## Compare the full basket total
A lower item price with higher shipping is not a saving. Compare what leaves your account.

## Join loyalty programmes early
Some retailers give members early access. Signing up a week ahead can mean first pick of limited stock.

posts.title: Stacking Coupons, Cashback and Sales: What Usually Works
posts.excerpt: How promo codes, cashback portals and store sales interact, and where the limits are.
posts.author: CouponBuz Team
posts.seoTitle: Can You Stack Coupons, Cashback and Sales? A Guide
posts.seoDescription: Understand how promo codes, cashback and sale prices combine, and which combinations retailers typically allow.
posts.body:
Layering savings can add up, but each retailer sets its own rules.

## Sale price plus a code
Some stores let a code apply on top of a sale price, while others restrict codes to full-price items. The terms line on the offer should say which.

## Codes and cashback
Cashback portals track your purchase through a special link. Applying a code does not always cancel cashback, but some retailers void tracking if you use a code from outside the portal. Read the portal's terms.

## Loyalty points
Points are usually earned on the amount you actually pay, so a discount can reduce the points you collect. Decide which matters more for the purchase.

## Gift cards
Buying a discounted gift card for a store you use often is a simple way to save. Check that the card is from an authorised seller.

## Keep it simple
If stacking requires lots of steps, the saving may not be worth your time. Aim for one clear discount on things you were going to buy anyway.

posts.title: Why Promo Codes Stop Working (and What to Try Instead)
posts.excerpt: Expiry, usage limits, account rules and basket conditions explain most failed codes.
posts.author: CouponBuz Team
posts.seoTitle: Why Promo Codes Stop Working and What to Do Next
posts.seoDescription: The most common reasons a promo code fails at checkout, with simple fixes you can try in a minute.
posts.body:
When a code is rejected, one of a handful of things is usually happening.

## The offer has ended
Retailers end promotions on a date, or when stock or budget runs out. Codes can stop working before the stated expiry.

## The code has a usage limit
Single-use codes and per-customer limits are common. If you have used a similar offer before, you may not be eligible.

## Your basket does not qualify
Minimum spends, excluded brands and category limits all cause rejections. Remove excluded items and try again.

## The region does not match
A code made for one country will fail on another country's site. Check you are on the right regional store.

## The code was copied wrongly
Codes are often case-sensitive. A stray space at the end is another frequent culprit.

## What to try next
Look for a newsletter welcome offer, check the retailer's own sale page, or wait for the next seasonal event.

pages.title: About CouponBuz
pages.seoDescription: CouponBuz is an independent promo code and deals site for shoppers in the US, UK, Canada and Europe.
pages.body:
CouponBuz helps shoppers in the US, UK, Canada and Europe find promo codes and deals without trawling through expired offers.

## What we do
We list offers from stores across fashion, electronics, travel, software, food delivery and more. Each listing shows its terms, its region and when it was last checked.

## What we do not do
We do not sell products and we never ask for payment details. When you click through to a store, you buy directly from that store.

## How we keep listings useful
Expired offers are removed, and sample listings are clearly labelled. If you spot something wrong, [contact us](/contact/) and we will review it.

## How we are funded
We may earn a commission when you buy through our links. Read more on our [affiliate disclosure page](/how-we-make-money/).

pages.title: How We Check Offers
pages.seoDescription: How CouponBuz reviews, dates and removes promo codes so listings stay accurate.
pages.body:
A code is only useful if it works, so we keep a simple process for every listing.

## Review
Each offer is added with its discount, terms, region and expiry date taken from the retailer or its affiliate programme.

## Date stamp
We record when an offer was last checked. Offers without a recent check are marked and are removed if we cannot confirm them.

## Removal
Offers past their expiry date disappear from the site on the next update. Reader reports of failed codes move an offer up the review queue.

## Limits
Retailers can change or end promotions at any time, and some codes depend on your account or basket. We cannot guarantee that every code works for every customer.

CouponBuz is free to use. We earn money in the following ways.

## Affiliate commissions
Many links on this site are affiliate links. If you click one and make a purchase, the retailer may pay us a commission. The price you pay does not change.

## Editorial independence
Commission does not decide which offers we publish or how we describe them. We list offers because they are useful to shoppers, and we label sample content clearly.

## Advertising
We may display advertising in future. Any sponsored placement will be labelled as such.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.seoDescription: How CouponBuz handles visitor data, cookies and analytics.
pages.body:
This policy explains what information CouponBuz collects and why. It is a starting template; have it reviewed by a legal professional before relying on it.

## Information we collect
We collect basic usage data such as pages viewed and device type through analytics tools, if enabled. We do not require you to create an account to browse.

## Cookies
We use cookies for site functions and analytics. Where required by law, such as in the EU and UK, we ask for your consent before setting non-essential cookies.

## Offers you submit
If you send us an offer through the submit form, we store what you enter (store, code, description and an optional email address) so that we can review it. Submissions are not published until a person has checked them. Tell us if you would like a submission deleted.

## Third parties
When you click an affiliate link, the retailer and its tracking partners may set their own cookies. Their policies apply on their sites.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct or delete your data. Contact us to make a request.

## Changes
We may update this policy and will show the date of the latest change on this page.

collections.intro: Black Friday rewards preparation. Browse stores that usually run the biggest sales and check each offer's terms before the rush.
collections.body:
## How to prepare
Record today's prices for the things you want, set a total budget and compare the final basket total, including delivery, rather than the headline discount.

## What to expect
Electronics and home retailers tend to publish early deals, while fashion and beauty brands often release limited-time codes closer to the weekend. Offers on this page are labelled with their check date so you can tell what is fresh.

collections.seoDescription: Christmas 2026 gift deals and promo codes across fashion, beauty, home and travel for the US, UK, Canada and Europe.
collections.intro: Spread the cost of gifts by checking for codes and member prices before you pay, and note delivery cut-off dates.
collections.body:
## Plan around delivery dates
Last-order dates for Christmas delivery differ by store and country, so check them first, then look for savings.

## Where savings hide
Gift sets, loyalty reward days and free-delivery thresholds often beat a small percentage code. Compare the full basket before choosing.
